outcome: Reduce the Outer Blackboard to a smaller value-bearing control plane: keep only semantics that change routing, authority, context quality or delivery trust, and remove derived, duplicate or legacy structures that add ceremony without independent decision value.
currentProblem: The delivered Blackboard now has enough operational history to distinguish controls from ceremony. Current main carries several structures that are derivable, constant, legacy-only or unused by the contracted delivery path: every Feature is one-to-one with one Task; dependency requires metadata is effectively constant; committed state/current-context projections are rebuildable and non-authoritative; legacy context transition modules have no current runtime consumer; and parts of the component/task schema are validated but do not affect scheduling, context or delivery. This increases plan/schema surface, merge churn and fresh-agent onboarding complexity.
constraints: Preserve the two lanes RESEARCH_SA and WORKER, phase semantics, one-task claim ownership, direct task dependency ordering, exact objective/plan bindings, independent Jev judgment, negative-case binding, Living Docs consolidation and exact candidate/evidence/merge delivery verification.
Do not change Jev verdict semantics, provider policy, worker evidence retention, OBJECTIVE_SUPERSESSION semantics or delivery receipt semantics in this cleanup.

Do not remove a field or layer merely because it is aesthetically redundant; removal requires either no current consumer, a derivable equivalent, or a replacement that preserves the same decision/authority value.
Migrate current unfinished tasks deterministically and preserve terminal receipts/artifacts without rewriting historical evidence.
Fresh-agent onboarding must not regress: the post-cleanup bootstrap must recover the exact task, lane/phase, current-system refs, plan scope and legal next action without prior conversation.
successCriteria: The graph no longer carries a Feature layer when every Feature is one-to-one with one Task; Tasks bind directly to Topics and preserve all planning refs losslessly.

Rebuildable routing projections are no longer persisted as authority-adjacent state: fresh bootstrap derives context from canonical graph/plan/registry data without requiring current.json/currentContextRef, and the human state view is generated on demand rather than committed.

Graph and component schemas drop metadata that has no current decision consumer, including constant allocation literals, redundant dependency requires metadata, unused topic status, and legacy-only registry fields, while preserving the bounded context-routing value of Components.
Legacy outer-context code paths and one-time migration surfaces with no unfinished consumer are removed from runtime/tests/package scripts.
A focused before/after value check proves equivalent scheduling/authority/delivery behavior and no worse fresh-agent context sufficiency while reducing canonical schema/projection surface.
